descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 20 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Puzzles made of light, on your own table.

At the end of the day, put on your Quest 3 and a small stone-and-brass board appears on your real table. Place a mirror and the beam turns. Add a prism and it splits into colour. Every piece you set down plays a soft piano note, and when the last crystal lights up, your path plays back as a song you made.

Solve a board, then blow on the dandelion: its seeds float up and settle as stars on your real ceiling. Over time your room fills with keepsake crystals and quiet constellations.

• 49 hand-made puzzles in 8 sets: starts gentle, gets properly tricky
• Mirrors, prisms, coloured glass, a colour combiner and more
• The Light Garden: paint with light, no goals
• No controllers needed (controllers work too); pieces snap onto the board
• Seated, no timers, no fail, gentle hints when you're stuck
• Any table or desk works; your room setup adds the ceiling and wall moments

Made by a solo developer who gets sick in full VR: no movement, you never leave your room.
